patterns.note: Full-bleed product photography and video backgrounds are used extensively to create an immersive and premium visual experience.
Content sections alternate between dark grey and light grey backgrounds, providing clear visual separation and hierarchy.
Prominent, large, uppercase sans-serif headings are used for key section titles, creating a strong, modern visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast monochrome palette (dark grey, white, light grey) dominates, with product imagery providing the only subtle color accents.
A large, full-width product image is fixed in the background while descriptive text content scrolls over it, creating a subtle parallax effect.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Detailed ingredient and benefit explanations are presented in a clear, structured manner, often using bullet points or short, focused paragraphs.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero section plays on a loop in the background, with a dark overlay to ensure text readability and a prominent call-to-action button.
A sticky navigation bar remains at the top of the viewport, providing consistent access to site links.
A large, full-width product image is positioned to remain fixed or slowly parallax in the background as descriptive text scrolls over it, creating a layered depth effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual breaks, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, input fields, and product images have slightly rounded corners, typically 4-8px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel, especially in the hero and product detail sections.

standout: The site's design stands out with its sophisticated, high-contrast monochrome aesthetic, leveraging large-scale, stark product photography and video to convey a sense of luxury and transparency. The distinctive use of a fixed/parallaxing product image with scrolling text overlay creates a unique visual depth, while the persistent pre-order modal ensures immediate call-to-action visibility.
